MainComponents.name: Brake Pedal
MainComponents.description: Driver-operated lever to apply braking force.

MainComponents.name: Brake Booster (Servo)
MainComponents.description: Uses vacuum assistance to reduce pedal effort.

MainComponents.name: Master Cylinder
MainComponents.description: Converts pedal pressure into hydraulic pressure.

MainComponents.name: Brake Lines / Hoses
MainComponents.description: Carries brake fluid to wheel cylinders or calipers.

MainComponents.name: Proportioning Valve
MainComponents.description: Balances pressure between front and rear brakes.

MainComponents.name: Brake Fluid Reservoir
MainComponents.description: Stores brake fluid for the hydraulic circuit.

DiscBrakeSystem.name: Brake Disc (Rotor)
DiscBrakeSystem.description: Spinning disc squeezed by pads to create friction.

DiscBrakeSystem.name: Brake Caliper
DiscBrakeSystem.description: Holds brake pads and applies hydraulic force.

DiscBrakeSystem.name: Brake Pads
DiscBrakeSystem.description: Friction elements pressed against rotor to slow the wheel.

DiscBrakeSystem.name: Caliper Pistons
DiscBrakeSystem.description: Push pads against the rotor under fluid pressure.

DrumBrakeSystem.name: Brake Drum
DrumBrakeSystem.description: Rotating drum used with brake shoes to produce braking force.

DrumBrakeSystem.name: Brake Shoes
DrumBrakeSystem.description: Friction linings that press against the drum interior.

DrumBrakeSystem.name: Wheel Cylinder
DrumBrakeSystem.description: Hydraulic cylinder that pushes brake shoes outward.

ParkingBrakeComponents.name: Handbrake Lever
ParkingBrakeComponents.description: Manual control for parking brake activation.

ParkingBrakeComponents.name: Parking Brake Cable
ParkingBrakeComponents.description: Transfers mechanical force from lever to brakes.

ParkingBrakeComponents.name: Parking Brake Actuator
ParkingBrakeComponents.description: Electronic motor applies the brake automatically.

ElectronicAndSensorComponents.name: ABS Module
ElectronicAndSensorComponents.description: Prevents wheel lock-up by modulating brake pressure.

ElectronicAndSensorComponents.name: Wheel Speed Sensor
ElectronicAndSensorComponents.description: Detects wheel rotation speed for ABS/ESC systems.

ElectronicAndSensorComponents.name: Brake Pressure Sensor
ElectronicAndSensorComponents.description: Measures hydraulic pressure in brake lines.

ElectronicAndSensorComponents.name: Electronic Brake Control Unit (ECU)
ElectronicAndSensorComponents.description: Processes sensor data and controls braking functions.

SupportingHardware.name: Brake Mounting Brackets
SupportingHardware.description: Holds caliper and other components in place.

SupportingHardware.name: Brake Dust Shield
SupportingHardware.description: Protects rotors from debris and heat.

SupportingHardware.name: Bleeder Screws
SupportingHardware.description: Used to release air from brake lines during bleeding.
